description: Core capabilities: general-purpose tools any worker may be given, each explicitly. None is given by default; an integration that needs one says why (coreWhy), and the worker's definition lists it. Integration-provided tools (Figma, Builder.io, the Git workflow) are never here.

capabilities.summary: Read files in the run's workspace.
Create and edit files in the run's workspace. Never in an Inspect workspace, and not on a protected branch.
Run node and curl commands. Not in Inspect, not under a protected-branch policy, and not in the hosted product.
Search the web and read public pages.
Open pages in a browser (in Inspect: open and read only).

general.why: The General worker has no definition: it gets only the core tools granted to it here (General settings), within the workspace's, Team's and platform's limits. Shell (node, curl) is never a default: a shell command runs with the person's own OS permissions, outside every file rule, so it must be granted explicitly.
